b: Home Depot has some plumbing hand tool deals within their Black Friday tool deals and gifts center.

I always wonder about the mindset here, to place trades staples in between discounted impulse buys, but I guess it makes sense. Maybe these are for apprentices looking to built their tool kit, or seasoned pros who are about to replace a worn tool and are eager to try something new.
The discounts are slim, but some savings are better than nothing.
Here are the different kinds of plumbing fixture mounting nuts the faucet wrench can work on.
These are good adjustable wrenches. Not my favorite, but strong and reliable.
I really like Milwaukee’s tubing cutters. I haven’t worn mine to the point of replacing its blade yet. It provides quick, easy, and clean cuts whenever I need to cut soft tubing.
Milwaukee Mini Copper Tubing Cutter and Reaming Pen – $24.88

Just the 1-inch mini copper tubing cutter sells for $23.97 by itself, and the deburring tool is $9.97. If you need both, this bundle saves you around $9. The deburring tool also be used on PVC tubing, not just copper.
There are also tons of deals on general purpose cordless power tools – drills, drivers, recip saws, and similar core tools. But it’s good to see some trades-specific core tool deals too.
